blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Camera design heavily influences perception task performance, yet cameras are typically designed by domain experts through costly experimentation, in isolation from the tasks they serve. Existing joint-design methods either rely on differentiable simulation limited to pre-captured 2D images, restricting them to optics or image-processing pipeline design, or use non-differentiable camera simulators optimised with derivative-free or reinforcement-learning methods that scale poorly with the number of design parameters. We present a differentiable framework for jointly designing complex camera systems and downstream perception tasks. We use it to design two coded-aperture depth-from-defocus cameras, a monocular and a stereo configuration, by jointly optimising the coded aperture mask, camera parameters, and a depth estimation network end-to-end. Our framework represents scenes with 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstructed from real-world captures, providing a differentiable image formation process for gradient-based optimisation over design spaces intractable for prior differentiable approaches. Results demonstrate that our differentiable method improves over existing coded aperture design and non-differentiable camera design baselines, offering a step forward in automated and principled camera design for autonomous systems.
blocks.zh: 相机设计严重影响了感知任务性能,然而相机通常由域专家通过昂贵的实验设计,与他们所服务的任务隔离. 现有的联合设计方法或者依靠限于预摄2D图像的不同模拟,仅限于光学或图像处理管道设计,或者使用无差异的相机模拟器,优化后采用衍生的无阻或加固的学习方法,这些方法与设计参数数量相比规模差. 我们为联合设计复杂的相机系统和下游感知任务提供了一个不同的框架。 我们用它来设计两台编码-孔径深度从脱焦相机,一个单镜头和立体构型,共同优化编码孔径罩,相机参数,以及深度估计网络端到端. 我们的框架代表的场景是3D Gaussian Splating从现实世界的捕捉中重建而来,它为基于梯度的优化提供了一种不同的图像形成过程,而设计空间对于以前不同的方法来说是难以克服的。 结果表明,我们不同的方法比现有的编码孔径设计和无差别相机设计基线有所改善,为自主系统自动化和有原则的相机设计提供了一步。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Figure 1 : We introduce a differentiable method that jointly optimises camera parameters and perception tasks, using 3DGS scenes reconstructed from real-world captures and a coded aperture simulation modelling depth-dependent optical blur. Camera parameters and the perception network are jointly updated via gradient-based optimisation of the task loss (red arrows), spanning geometric parameters (FoV, pixel count, multi-camera configurations) and high-dimensional optical parameters (coded aperture mask).
blocks.zh: 图1:我们采用了一种不同的方法,共同选择相机参数和感知任务,使用由现实世界捕获重建的3DGS场景和编码孔径模拟模型深度依赖光学模糊. 相机参数和感知网络通过基于梯度的优化任务损失(红箭),跨越几何参数(FoV,像素计数,多相机配置)和高维光学参数(编码孔径口罩)共同更新.

blocks.en: The quality of camera captures directly governs the performance of downstream perception tasks, yet different autonomous systems require different camera designs to suit their tasks: autonomous vehicles need wide field of view (FoV) and high dynamic range, medical imaging needs fine resolution and colour fidelity, and robotics needs reliable depth and colour sensing. Hence, cameras should be designed in a task-specific manner.
blocks.zh: 相机捕捉的质量直接制约下游感知任务的执行,然而不同的自发系统需要不同的相机设计来适应它们的任务:自发的飞行器需要宽视场(FoV)和高活性范围,医学成像需要精细的分辨率和色彩的忠贞,而机器人需要可靠的深度和色彩感知. 因此,相机的设计应针对具体任务。

blocks.en: Many works jointly optimise imaging systems and perception tasks via differentiable simulation and gradient-based optimisers [ 33 , 5 , 36 , 16 , 8 , 46 , 12 ] . However, their reliance on pre-captured 2D image datasets prevents generalisation to broader design problems such as FOV, resolution, multi-camera configurations, or unconventional architectures, limiting them to designing parts of the camera system (e.g., optics or the image signal processing pipeline) rather than full camera systems.
blocks.zh: 许多工程通过不同的模拟和以梯度为基础的选择器共同优化成像系统和感知任务[33、5、36、16、8、46、12]。 然而,他们依赖于预取的2D影像数据集,使得一般化无法被概括到更广泛的设计上的问题,如FOV,分辨率,多相机配置,或非常规架构等,使其仅限于设计相机系统的部件(如光学或图像信号处理管道),而不是全相机系统.

blocks.en: Other works design full camera systems using 3D simulation environments, but treat the simulator as a non-differentiable black box, relying on reinforcement-learning [ 20 ] or derivative-free [ 44 , 35 , 43 ] optimisers that ignore gradient information and must optimise for long iterations. This becomes prohibitively inefficient as the number of design parameters grows, particularly for high-dimensional parameters such as a coded aperture mask.
blocks.zh: 其他作品采用3D模拟环境设计全相机系统,但将模拟器视为一个无差别的黑匣子,依靠强化-学习[20]或衍生出无[44,35,43]选择器,忽略了梯度信息,必须优化长时间迭代. 随着设计参数数量的增加,特别是密码孔径口罩等高维度参数,这变得效率低下。

blocks.en: In this work, we propose a differentiable method for jointly designing complex camera systems and downstream perception tasks (Figure 1 ), using 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) [ 18 ] for scene representation and differentiable image formation. This enables gradient-based optimisation of optics, sensors, and placement while retaining the capacity to model complex, unconventional camera systems beyond the reach of prior differentiable methods. Since 3DGS scenes can be reconstructed from real-world captures, our method trains on both rendered and captured data; discrete parameters such as the coded aperture mask and sensor selection are optimised via a continuous-relaxation surrogate gradient. We demonstrate scalability to high-dimensional design spaces by jointly optimising a coded aperture mask with the remaining camera parameters and a depth-from-defocus perception task, for both single-camera and stereo configurations, analysing the resulting design trade-offs, an analysis made possible by our 3DGS-based representation and largely overlooked in prior coded aperture work. In summary, our contributions are: • We introduce a differentiable framework that jointly optimises camera systems and their perception networks using 3DGS scenes reconstructed from real-world captures. • We use this framework to design both monocular and stereo coded aperture cameras, via a depth-from-defocus network augmented with a frequency injection module and extended to the stereo setup. • We systematically compare against existing camera design approaches and demonstrate significant improvements (e.g., up to 65% lower all-in-focus (AiF) LPIPS and 13% lower depth RMSE compared to the strongest baseline in the monocular setup), and analyse the design trade-offs between camera parameters, aperture masks, and task performance.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们提出了一种不同的方法,用于联合设计复杂的相机系统和下游感知任务(图1),使用3D高斯平板(3DGS) [18] 来进行场景表现和不同的图像形成. 这使得光学、传感器和定位能够以梯度为基础优化,同时保留模拟复杂、非常规相机系统的能力,超出以往不同方法的可及范围。 由于3DGS场景可以从现实世界的捕捉中重建出来,因此我们的方法在渲染和捕获的数据上进行训练;像编码孔径口罩和传感器选择这样的离散参数通过连续放行代位梯度来优化. 我们通过联合优化带其余相机参数的编码孔径罩和从深度到分焦的感知任务,对单相机和立体相机的配置,分析由此产生的设计取舍,通过我们基于3DGS的表示制成的分析,可以实现高维设计空间的可伸缩性,在先前的编码孔径工作中基本上被忽视。 简而言之,我们的贡献是:我们采用了一个不同的框架,利用从现实世界中重新构建出来的3DGS场景,共同选择相机系统及其感知网络。 我们利用这个框架设计了单相和立体编码孔径相机,通过一个从深度到分焦的网络,加了一个频率注入模块,并扩展到立体设置。 我们系统地与现有的相机设计方法进行比较,并显示出显著的改进(例如,与单相机布置中最强的基准相比,全焦(AiF)LPIPS和低深度RMSE的降低高达65%),并分析相机参数、孔径口罩和任务性能之间的设计取舍。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Task-Driven Camera Design Designing cameras for perception tasks improves performance, though many approaches rely on non-differentiable simulators. Early work used renderers such as ISET [ 40 , 39 ] to prototype cameras and manually tune parameters against task outcomes [ 4 , 24 , 23 , 41 , 25 ] , trading laborious manual iteration for lower development cost. Later work automates this with reinforcement-learning [ 20 , 15 ] or evolutionary [ 44 , 43 , 35 ] methods that bypass large networks for faster, more data-efficient optimisation. Treating the simulator as a black box, however, makes these methods inefficient with high-dimensional or numerous parameters such as a coded aperture mask, which our method handles efficiently via gradient-based optimisation while retaining full camera system support.
blocks.zh: 任务驱动相机设计相机用于感知任务可以提高性能,虽然许多方法都依赖于无差别的模拟器. 早期的工作利用了ISET等渲染器[40,39]来原型相机和手动调谐参数来对抗任务结果[4,24,23,41,25],为降低开发成本而进行辛勤的手工迭代. 后来的工作将这个自动化为强化-学习[20,15]或演化[44,43,35]方法,这些方法绕过大型网络,以更快,更高效的数据优化. 然而,将模拟器当作一个黑匣子来对待,使得这些方法在高维或众多参数(如编码孔径口罩)下效率低下,我们的方法通过梯度优化高效地处理,同时保留了完整的相机系统支持.

blocks.en: Another line of work instead leverages differentiable simulation to jointly optimise camera parameters and the perception task, applied to depth of field [ 33 , 34 , 45 ] , object detection [ 37 , 36 , 31 , 8 ] , image classification [ 5 , 9 , 49 , 46 ] , depth estimation [ 14 , 6 , 16 , 1 ] , HDR imaging [ 27 , 26 ] , and motion deblurring [ 30 ] . These methods simulate cameras’ effect on pre-captured 2D images, however, limiting generalisation to variable FoV, resolution, unconventional configurations, or multi-camera systems. Our approach instead constructs the full environment in 3D using 3DGS, supporting such scenarios while retaining differentiability.
blocks.zh: 另一行工作则利用不同的模拟,联合优化相机参数和感知任务,应用于地深[33,34,45],物体探测[37,36,31,8],图像分类[5,9,49,46],深度估计[14,6,16,1],HDR成像[27,26],运动分解[30]. 这些方法模拟相机对预摄取的2D图像的影响,但将通化限制在可变的FOV,分辨率,非常规配置,或多相机系统. 相反,我们的方法是使用3DGS以3D构建整个环境,支持这种设想,同时保留不同的环境。

blocks.en: Coded Aperture Imaging Coded aperture imaging modifies the aperture to encode scene-dependent blur, improving depth and AiF recovery. Early work showed that appropriately designed aperture patterns improve the conditioning of depth-from-defocus and deblurring [ 21 , 38 , 50 ] , and recent methods jointly optimise the aperture code and reconstruction network end-to-end using amplitude [ 32 ] or phase masks [ 13 , 42 , 16 ] . Ghanekar et al. [ 12 ] extended this to dual-pixel sensors, learning an amplitude mask that trades depth estimation against deblurring.
blocks.zh: 被编码的孔径成像可编码的孔径成像会修改孔径,以编码依赖场景的模糊,提高深度和AiF恢复. 早期的研究表明,经过适当设计的孔径模式可以改善从分焦到分分焦的深度和分光的调节[21、38、50],最近的方法可以共同优化孔径编码和重建网络的端到端,使用振幅[32]或相相口罩[13、42、16]。 Ghanekar 等人著. [12] 将它扩展至双像素传感器,学习振幅口罩,将深度估计与去色相交换.

blocks.en: These methods optimise the aperture mask alone, whereas we treat coded aperture imaging as a broader co-design problem, jointly optimising the mask with other camera parameters for task-driven objectives. This enables systematic exploration of trade-offs such as depth accuracy, noise, and defocus blur, and we further extend coded aperture imaging to stereo-camera systems.
blocks.zh: 这些方法仅优化了孔径口罩,而我们则将编码孔径成像作为一个更广泛的共设计问题,将口罩与其他相机参数同步优化,以达到任务驱动的目标. 这使得能够系统地探索取舍,如深度精确度、噪音和去焦模糊度,我们进一步将编码孔径成像扩大到立体相机系统。

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Figure 2 : A camera captures the real-world scene (blue arrow), which 3DGS models as a 3D Gaussian representation. At each step, this representation is rendered with the current geometric camera parameters into pinhole RGB images and depth maps; the coded aperture simulation then convolves these RGB renders with depth-dependent PSFs computed from the coded mask, focus distance, and f-number via a physical optics model, followed by a physics-based noise model. The resulting renders are fed to the perception task network, and the task loss l task l_{\text{task}} is backpropagated through both stages (red arrows) to jointly update all learnable parameters (green text).
blocks.zh: 图2:相机能捕捉出真实世界的场景(蓝色箭头),而3DGS模型是3D高斯代表. 在每一个步骤上,这种表示用目前的几何相机参数制成针孔 RGB 图像和深度图;编码孔径模拟然后将这些RGB制成的具有深度依赖性的PSF通过一个物理光学模型来计算,然后通过一个物理噪声模型来计算. 结果的成份被输入到感知任务网络中,任务损失lxixtext{ task}被反传到两个阶段(红箭头),共同更新所有可学习参数(绿色文本).

blocks.en: We propose a differentiable framework that jointly optimises camera design and downstream perception tasks using a 3DGS scene representation, as illustrated in Figure 2 .
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一个不同的框架,通过3DGS场景展示,共同选择相机设计和下游感知任务,如图2所示。

blocks.en: 3.1 Scene Representation and Image Formation
blocks.zh: 3.1 场景表现和图像形成

blocks.en: We represent the 3D scene using 3DGS [ 18 ] , a differentiable splatting-based representation reconstructed before optimisation from a set of input images, which renders RGB images and depth maps via alpha-compositing. We assume a pinhole projection model, though other camera models could be used; this yields analytical gradients with respect to camera parameters, enabling gradient-based joint optimisation of intrinsics (e.g., focal length, sensor dimensions) and extrinsics (e.g., placement, orientation).
blocks.zh: 我们用 3DGS [18] 代表了3D场景,这是一种在优化之前从一组输入图像中重建的可分解的镀层代表,它通过alpha-composition使RGB图像和深度映射. 我们假设采用针孔投影模型,尽管可以使用其他相机模型;这会产生相机参数的分析梯度,使内在物(例如焦距、传感器维度)和外生物(例如位置、取向)能够以梯度为基础联合优化。

blocks.en: To simulate coded aperture defocus, we apply an occlusion-aware layered blur model adapted from Ikoma et al. [ 16 ] : the rendered scene is quantised into discrete depth layers, each convolved with a depth-dependent point spread function (PSF) determined by the coded mask, focus distance, and f-number, then composited back-to-front using the depth maps to account for occlusion between layers.
blocks.zh: 为了模拟编码孔径分焦,我们采用了由Ikoma等改编而成的闭合-感知分层模糊模型 [16]:所渲染的场景被分解为离散深度层,每个场景都由由被编码的口罩,焦距,和f-数所决定的由深度依赖的点散函数(PSF)相接而成,再用深度图来相接相接相接的相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相

blocks.en: Following [ 44 ] , we augment the rendered image with an affine noise model [ 11 ] combining signal-dependent Poisson noise and thermal noise calibrated on a physical camera. The calibrated noise parameters generalise to arbitrary exposure, gain, pixel size, and aperture size by scaling the effective gain with the ratios of pixel and aperture areas relative to the calibrated configuration, including the coded mask’s open-aperture fraction.
blocks.zh: 在[44]之后,我们用一个芬芳噪声模型来增强成像,[11]结合了信号依赖的波森噪声和在物理相机上校正的热噪声. 校正噪声参数通过以像素和孔径区域相对于校正配置的比例来缩放有效收益,包括被编码的口罩的开孔分数,来概括任意曝光、增益、像素大小和孔径大小。

blocks.en: 3.2 Perception Task
blocks.zh: 3.2 认知任务

blocks.en: Our framework is compatible with any differentiable perception task, but here we focus on an RGB-D task that jointly estimates depth from defocus blur and reconstructs an AiF image, as it depends directly on the optical parameters we optimise. Our monocular network builds on the depth-from-defocus architecture of Ikoma et al. [ 16 ] , which deconvolves the coded aperture image into a focal stack via a Tikhonov inverse filter and predicts the AiF image and depth map from the stack and coded image using a U-Net backbone. We augment this backbone with a frequency injection module that extracts local defocus cues from patch-wise Fourier spectra of the coded image and injects them at the U-Net bottleneck, improving depth separation.
blocks.zh: 我们的框架与任何不同的感知任务是相容的,但在这里我们专注于一个RGB-D任务,这个任务共同从分焦模糊中估算出深度并重建一个AiF图像,因为它直接依赖于我们优化的光学参数. 我们的单一网络以Ikoma等人的深度和重点结构为基础。 [16],通过Tikhonov反向滤波器将编码孔径图像分解为焦堆,并使用U-Net主干线从堆栈中预测出AiF图像和深度图并进行编码. 我们用一个频率注射模块来增强这个主干,该模块从编码图像的补丁Fourier光谱中取出局部去焦提示,并在U-Net瓶颈处注入这些提示,改善深度分离.

blocks.en: To demonstrate our method’s ability to design beyond a single camera, we extend this network to a stereo setup: we deconvolve each view’s coded aperture image into a focal stack as before, then fuse them into intermediate AiF images via a differentiable Laplacian sharpness measure for photometric consistency across views. Inspired by [ 7 ] , a frozen pretrained optical flow network, RAPIDFlow [ 29 ] , estimates disparity from these images and warps the right focal stack into the left view’s coordinate frame. The left and warped right stacks, together with a disparity-derived depth cue, are then fed into the same task network to predict the left view’s AiF image and depth map. Illustration diagrams of both setups are in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh: 为了证明我们设计方法的能力 超越一个相机,我们把这个网络扩展到一个立体结构: 我们像以前一样把每个视图的编码孔径图像 分解成一个焦距堆,然后把它们装入中间 AiF图像通过可分辨的Laplacian锐度测量,实现各种观点的光度一致性. 受 [7] 的启发,一个被冷冻的预受训练的光学流网,RAPIDFlow [29],估计了这些图像的相差,并把右相焦堆摆入了左视图的坐标框. 左侧和被扭曲的右上方堆栈,加上差异衍生的深度提示,然后被输入到同一任务网络,以预测左视图的AiF图像和深度图. 两种装置的示意图都在补充材料中。

blocks.en: 3.3 Optimisation
blocks.zh: 3.3 优化

blocks.en: We formulate our framework as a joint optimisation problem over the camera parameters and the perception task, as illustrated in Figure 2 . At each step, the 3DGS scene is rendered into RGB and depth images, passed through the coded aperture and noise simulation, and fed to the perception network; the resulting task loss l task l_{\text{task}} is backpropagated through the entire pipeline to jointly update all camera and network parameters using the Adam optimiser [ 19 ] .
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,我们制定的框架是相机参数和感知任务的共同优化问题。 在每一步,3DGS场景被制成RGB和深度图像,通过编码孔径和噪声模拟,并被输入到感知网络;由此而来的任务损失l任务l_{\text{task}}被通过整个输油管回传来联合更新所有相机和网络参数,使用Adam optimiser [19].

blocks.en: Camera Parameters We optimise the optics (focal length, f-number, coded aperture mask, focus distance) and image sensor (dimensions, pixel size) for the monocular setup, plus the baseline between cameras for the stereo setup. This loss discourages the optimiser from exploiting short focal lengths where the reconstruction is degenerate; it therefore constrains the effective design space rather than expressing a preference of the downstream perception task, and reflects a limitation of the 3DGS representation’s view coverage.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: We validate our method on two close-range design scenarios for depth-from-defocus and AiF reconstruction, focusing on short range because the defocus cue is less informative further out. The monocular case targets robotic grasping, recovering depth from a single camera over a confined workspace. The stereo case targets macro photography, where a zoomed-in view with a shallow depth of field (DoF) produces strong defocus blur; here a stereo pair adds complementary photometric and geometric depth cues.
blocks.zh: 我们用两种近距离设计方案来验证我们的方法,即从深度到非焦点和AiF重建,重点放在短距离上,因为去焦点提示的信息较少。 单相机箱瞄准机器人抓取,从单相机上取出深度于被封闭的工作空间. 立体相片以宏相片为拍摄目标,在外野(DoF)深度较浅的缩放视野中,会产生强烈的去聚焦模糊;在此一对立体相片中,会添加互补的光度测量和几何深度提示.

blocks.en: 4.1 Implementations
blocks.zh: 4.1 执行情况

blocks.en: Dataset and Environment We select close-range scenes from MipNeRF 360 [ 2 ] and LLFF [ 28 ] : 6 scenes ( leaves , flower , fortress , orchids , bonsai , room ) for the monocular case, and 7 scenes (the same 4 LLFF scenes plus counter , kitchen , bonsai from MipNeRF 360) for the stereo case. For each scene, we establish a 3D Gaussian representation with gsplat [ 47 ] as the virtual environment, then recover metric scale by aligning the reconstruction to metric depth from Depth Anything 3 [ 22 ] . The camera design and task network are jointly optimised across all scenes, with a subset of views per scene withheld for evaluation.
blocks.zh: 数据集与环境 我们从 MipNERF 360 [2] 和 LLFF [28] 中选择近距离场景:6场场景(叶子,花花,要塞,兰花, Bonsai,房间)用于独家案件,7场景(相同的4场LLFF场景加上柜台,厨房, Bonsai来自 MipNERF 360)用于立体案件. 对于每个场景,我们建立以gsplat [47]作为虚拟环境的3D高斯代表,然后通过从深度 Anything 3 [22] 调整重建到公尺深度来恢复度量尺度. 相机设计和任务网络在所有场景中共同优化,每个场景的分集视图不用于评价.

blocks.en: Noise Calibration We calibrate the noise model on a Basler Dart DaA1280-54uc camera [ 3 ] (5 ms exposure, 10 dB gain, f/8) following [ 44 ] . This configuration is treated as the reference point for generalisation.
blocks.zh: 噪声校正 我们校正Basler Dart DaA1280-54uc相机上的噪音模型 [3] (5ms曝光,10 dB增益,f/8) 后 [44]. 这种配置被作为通用的参考点.

blocks.en: Optimisation All camera parameters, coded aperture masks, and task networks are jointly optimised with Adam [ 19 ] for 20,000 steps with a batch size of 3, using a learning rate of 10 − 2 10^{-2} for the camera parameters and 10 − 3 10^{-3} for the mask and task networks.
blocks.zh: 优化 所有相机参数,编码孔径口罩,任务网络都与亚当[19]联合优化出两万步,分批大小为3个,采用相机参数的学习率为10−2 10×2}而口罩和任务网络的学习率为10−3 10×3}.

blocks.en: Design Space The design space covers the optical parameters (focal length ∈ [ 5 , 25 ] \in[5,25] mm, focus distance ∈ [ 0.1 , 5 ] \in[0.1,5] m, f-number ∈ [ 1.4 , 16 ] \in[1.4,16] , and a 17 × 17 17\times 17 px circular amplitude coded aperture mask) and the image sensor, chosen from a catalogue of 43 commercial CMOS sensors collected in [ 44 ] . Sensor size and focal length determine the FoV, while focal length and f-number determine the aperture size. The mask and sensor choice are optimised with the Gumbel-Softmax and STE formulation, as in Section 3.3 .
blocks.zh: 设计空间 设计空间涵盖光学参数(焦距为QQ [5,25]\ in [5,25] mm,焦距为QX [0.1,5] 在[0,15] m,f-数字为QX [1.4,16]\ in [1.4,16],以及从[44]所收集的43个商用CMOS传感器目录中选取的17×17 17相平方圆振幅编码孔径口罩)和图像传感器. 传感器大小和焦距决定了FOV,而焦距和f-数字则决定了孔径大小. 口罩和传感器的选择与Gumbel-Softmax和STE配方优化,如第3.3节。

blocks.en: Comparison We compare against TaCOS [ 44 ] , a genetic algorithm-based camera design method that jointly optimises camera parameters and the perception model, run for the same ∼ \sim 20,000-step budget (590 candidates over 34 generations, following its recommended 2 × 2\times -parameter population size for our 295 optimised parameters).
blocks.zh: 比较 我们比较TaCOS[44],一种基于遗传算法的相机设计方法,它联合选择相机参数和感知模型,运行于相同的\\sim 2万步预算(34代的590名候选人,遵循其推荐的2×2\时——参数大小,用于我们295个优化参数).

blocks.en: We also compare to the baseline depth-from-defocus method of Ikoma et al. [ 16 ] with a fixed camera, testing both their original phase mask, matched in element count, and an amplitude mask matched to our own settings. We use the catalogue’s largest-pixel sensor for the best SNR, and reuse their focus distance as it targets a similar depth range to our scenes. We scale the f-number and focal length to reproduce their aperture diameter, matching their level of defocus blur while keeping a reasonable FoV with our sensor. These camera parameters are listed in Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 我们还比较了Ikoma等人的基线深度 -- -- 脱重点方法。 [16] 固定相机,测试他们的原相口罩, 匹配元素计数, 和振幅口罩匹配 我们自己的设置。 我们用目录中最大的像素传感器来做最好的SNR, 并重新使用它们的焦距, 因为它瞄准了与我们场景相似的深度范围。 我们放大了f-数和焦距,以复制它们的孔径直径,将它们的去焦分水平相匹配,同时保持一个合理的FOV和我们的传感器. 这些相机参数见表1。

blocks.en: To highlight the benefit of a coded aperture, which recovers an AiF image from the blur caused by widening the aperture under low-light conditions, we evaluate all methods under two low-SNR scenarios with increased image noise, representing low-light operation or noisier sensors.
blocks.zh: 为了突出编码孔径的好处,即从低光条件下拓宽孔径所引发的模糊中恢复出AiF图像,我们评价了在两种低SNR情景下所有方法,图像噪声增加,代表了低光操作或噪声传感器.

blocks.en: Ikoma et al. [ 16 ] ’s fixed camera has a large aperture diameter, producing strong defocus blur across the scene depth range that severely limits AiF quality, as the task model must invert a poorly conditioned PSF with little residual texture. The amplitude mask compensates by concentrating transmittance near the aperture centre to shrink the PSF spread, while keeping sparse coding at the boundary to retain depth cues. AiF quality suffers, but depth metrics stay competitive since the large aperture still yields strong defocus cues. Under higher noise, both variants degrade only marginally, as the mask opens more pixels to maintain light throughput.
blocks.zh: Ikoma等 [16] 的固定相机有大孔径,在场景深度范围内产生强烈的去焦模糊,严重地限制了AiF的质量,因为任务模型必须倒置一个条件差的PSF,其残余纹理很少. 振幅口罩通过将传播集中在孔径中心附近来收缩PSF的传播,同时在边界上保持零星的编码来保留深度提示来弥补. AiF质量受到影响,但深度衡量标准仍然具有竞争力,因为大孔径仍然产生强烈的去焦提示。 在高噪声下,两种变体都只是轻微地降解,因为口罩会打开更多的像素来维持光的吞吐量.

blocks.en: TaCOS [ 44 ] selects a long focal length and high f-number. This reduces defocus blur relative to Ikoma et al. [ 16 ] and modestly improves AiF PSNR/SSIM, but LPIPS and depth accuracy remain substantially worse than others. We attribute this to two factors: TaCOS represents the mask as a 1D array, preventing it from learning 2D spatial coding patterns and hurting LPIPS in particular, and its derivative-free optimiser lacks gradient information to resolve interactions among the many camera parameters. Under Noise × \times 200, it lowers the f-number to widen the aperture, but also selects a smaller pixel size sensor that offsets the SNR gain, indicating that TaCOS struggles to find globally consistent configurations at this parameter scale, though more generations may help. It also takes substantially longer to optimise (3.6 h vs. our 2.1 h on a NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 GPU) due to the smaller pixel sizes it selects and its optimisation method.
blocks.zh: TaCOS [44] 选择了长焦长度和高f-数字. 与Ikoma等人相比,这减少了模糊性。 [16],并略微改进了AiF PSNR/SSIM,但LPIPS和深度精度仍然比其他的要差得多. 我们将此归因于两个因素: TaCOS 代表面具为一维阵列,使其无法学习二维空间编码模式并特别伤害到LPIPS,而它的衍生出无偏比器缺乏梯度信息来解决许多相机参数之间的相互作用. 在Noise ×\times 200下,它会降低f-数来拓宽孔径,但也会选择一个较小的像素尺寸传感器来抵消SNR增益,表明TaCOS在此参数尺度上努力寻找全球一致的配置,尽管更多的代可能有所帮助. 由于所选择的像素尺寸和优化方法较小,在NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 GPU上,优化(3.6 h vs. our 2.1 h)也需要更长的时间。

blocks.en: Our method converges to a short focal length and high f-number, giving a small aperture, ≈ \approx 1.0 mm under Noise × \times 100, and correspondingly large DoF that keeps the PSF well-conditioned across the workspace, enabling accurate AiF reconstruction while retaining enough residual defocus for the best depth results across all metrics. It also selects the largest available pixel size to maximise SNR at this small aperture, and the mask compensates for the small aperture area by opening more pixels to maintain light throughput. Under Noise × \times 200, it modestly increases the focal length and lowers the f-number, enlarging the aperture to ≈ \approx 1.3 mm to admit more light while keeping the same sensor. Despite the resulting increase in blur, it sustains strong performance and outperforms all baselines by a substantial margin in both scenarios. Note that the black-pixel regularisation loss discourages the optimiser from selecting even shorter focal lengths, so the converged values reported here reflect this constrained design space rather than an unconstrained preference of the perception task.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法集中到一个短焦距和高f-数,给出一个小孔径,在噪声××\times 100下为\\ 1.0 mm,相应的大型 DoF,使PSF在工作空间中保持良好的条件,使精确的AiF重建能够同时保留足够的剩余去聚焦,以获得所有度量下的最佳深度结果. 它还选择了最大的可用像素大小来在这个小孔径上使SNR最大化,而面具通过打开更多的像素来维持光的吞吐量来补偿小孔径面积. 在噪声×\times 200下,它会适度地增加焦距并降低f-数,将孔径扩展为\\\ 1.3毫米以承认更多的光而保持相同的传感器. 尽管由此导致的模糊性增加,但它维持了强劲的性能,并在两种假设中大大超过所有基线。 注意:黑像素正则化的丢失会阻碍Opimiser选择更短的焦距,因此这里所报道的趋同值反映了这种受限制的设计空间,而不是感知任务的不受限制的偏好.

blocks.en: Comparison We compare against our own monocular design (under the same FoV), the strongest method from the monocular experiment, and against CADS [ 12 ] , a dual-pixel method that jointly learns a coded mask with a depth-estimation task. A dual-pixel camera is conceptually similar to a stereo pair in that it captures two views from slightly different perspectives by splitting the aperture into two halves, each projecting onto a separate photodiode within each pixel, but its effective baseline is limited to the aperture diameter rather than a physical camera separation. We match its focal length, sensor, and aperture diameter (via f-number) to our setup, but use our optimised focus distance in place of its own, as the original setting targets an extremely shallow depth range unsuitable for our scenes. All experiments use the same low-SNR scenarios and metrics as the monocular study.

blocks.en: Our method converges to a complementary two-view design: the left camera takes the maximum f-number ( f = 16.0 f{=}16.0 , aperture ≈ \approx 1.56 mm) and a short focus distance (0.26 m), maximising DoF for the sharpest possible AiF base images, while the right camera focuses further out (0.89 m) at a lower f-number ( ≈ \approx 11.3, aperture ≈ \approx 2.2 mm), adding depth cues from a different focal plane. The optimised baseline is very small ( b = 10 b{=}10 mm), which is enough for accurate right-to-left warping and photometric fusion, but not larger, since defocus already provides strong geometric depth cues at this range. This complementary design consistently improves on the monocular baseline, most notably in perceptual quality and depth accuracy. The masks follow the same logic: the left mask mirrors the monocular one (small central opening, sparse coded periphery, since it carries the primary supervision signal), while the right mask opens more, and asymmetrically towards the side away from the left camera. This is the region occluded from the left view, where the optimiser raises aperture weight to capture complementary information. Under Noise × \times 200, both masks open further to compensate for SNR, and the stereo method retains its AiF and depth advantage over monocular. The MAE gain vanishes, however, as the extra noise degrades the deconvolved focal stack feeding the disparity estimator, weakening the right-to-left warp and depth prior.

blocks.en: CADS [ 12 ] matches our monocular AiF PSNR but is markedly worse in perceptual quality, indicating it preserves mean intensity at the expense of texture. This also shows that our Tikhonov-deconvolution step aids AiF reconstruction. Its depth accuracy is considerably weaker, which we attribute to a depth-range mismatch: CADS is trained on defocus size for depth, and targets millimetre-scale scenes (e.g. endoscopy) where defocus size varies monotonically with depth. Our 0.1–5 m range instead makes this relationship non-linear and ambiguous near the focus plane, so supervising on defocus size no longer yields accurate depth, and its dual-pixel baseline is also too small to compensate geometrically. Its mask reflects this: a large open centre with sparse peripheral coding that splits the aperture to encode disparity rather than modulating spatial frequency, limiting its coding richness relative to our masks that are free across the full aperture area.
blocks.zh: CADS[12]与我们的单体AiF PSNR相匹配,但是在知觉质量上明显更差,表明它以牺牲纹理为代价保持了平均强度. 这也表明,我们的提克霍诺夫脱离革命的步骤有助于爱联的重建。 它的深度精度相当弱,我们将其归因于深度不匹配: CADS是针对深度的去焦点大小进行训练的,目标为毫米大小的场景(如内分镜),其中去焦点大小随深度而单调相去. 相反,我们0.1至5米的射程使得这种关系在焦平面附近是非线性的和模糊的,因此对去焦大小的监督不再产生准确的深度,它的双像素基线也太小,无法进行几何补偿. 它的口罩反映了这一点:一个庞大的开口中心,其外围编码稀少,将孔径分割为编码差异,而不是调节空间频率,限制了其编码丰富性,而我们的口罩则跨越了全孔径区域。

blocks.en: We isolate the contribution of key design choices in both experiments under Noise × \times 100. Results are in Table 3 .

blocks.en: For the monocular method, fixing the mask to the human-designed pattern of Levin et al. [ 21 ] makes the camera optimiser widen the aperture to compensate for its lower open fraction. Performance still slightly degrades across all metrics, however, demonstrating that optimising camera parameters alone cannot recover the spatial structure of a jointly optimised 2D mask. Fixing the camera to the Ikoma et al. [ 16 ] configuration substantially reduces AiF quality, confirming that its large aperture and shallow DoF limit reconstruction. It still outperforms the equivalent fixed-camera baseline from the main comparison, however, showing that our model and losses help even without camera optimisation. Removing the frequency injection module (reverting to the Ikoma et al. backbone) leaves AiF quality largely unchanged but degrades depth accuracy. The optimiser compensates with a longer focal length to increase blur, confirming the module mainly aids depth estimation via depth-dependent defocus features.

blocks.en: For the stereo method, sharing camera parameters across views collapses both to the left-camera design, removing the complementary focus split and degrading both AiF and depth. The right-view mask compensates by becoming horizontally anisotropic, encoding directional defocus cues since it can no longer differentiate through focus or aperture. Sharing a mask across views causes a modest AiF drop (LPIPS 0.177 vs. 0.161) but slightly improves depth (RMSE 0.083 vs. 0.084), as identical defocus patterns give more photometrically consistent input to the disparity estimator. Replacing the coded mask with a conventional open aperture, reducing to a standard stereo camera, significantly degrades AiF reconstruction (LPIPS 0.236 vs. 0.161): an uncoded circular aperture produces a PSF that is poorly conditioned for deconvolution, so sharpness cannot be recovered through reconstruction the way it can with the coded pattern. Depth accuracy degrades mildly, as stereo disparity still recovers depth correctly over most of the scene, though the weaker AiF reconstruction locally blurs the depth prediction near edges. Removing the warping stage pushes the right camera to a much longer focus distance and wider aperture, creating stronger and more spatially distinctive blur that can be exploited without requiring pixel-level correspondence. This only mildly hurts depth accuracy but degrades AiF (LPIPS 0.205 vs. 0.161). The mask also opens more on the side overlapping the left camera’s FoV, the region of highest cross-view photometric consistency it can still exploit without explicit correspondence.

blocks.en: 4.5 Real-World Validation
blocks.zh: 4.5 真实世界验证

blocks.en: We further validate our method on a prototype built from a commercial FLIR Flea3 camera [ 10 ] with a C-mount lens (Figure 5 ) due to manufacturing constraints. Hence, this validation focuses on optimising the coded mask, focus distance, and perception network, with the remaining optics fixed. The test scene’s 3DGS representation is added to the training set, though the evaluated view itself is not part of the training views. We validate both the monocular and stereo settings, with setup details, PSF calibrations, and monocular results reported in the supplementary material. The stereo camera is achieved by moving the camera by the baseline distance, and the corresponding results are shown in Figure 5 . The real-world behaviour matches our simulation: the stereo method focuses each view at a different depth to fuse complementary cues for AiF reconstruction, and the recovered depth aligns with the true scene geometry, confirming the method’s applicability beyond simulation.
blocks.zh: 由于制造限制,我们进一步验证了使用商用FLIR Flea3相机[10]所制造的原型,并配有C-山镜头(图5. 因此,这种验证侧重于优化被编码的口罩、焦距和感知网络,其余的光学固定。 测试场景的3DGS代表被添加到训练集中,尽管被评价的观点本身并不是训练观点的一部分. 我们验证单相和立体设置,并附有设置细节,PSF校正,以及补充材料中报告的单相结果. 立体相机是通过将相机按基线距离移动来实现的,相应的结果见图5. 真实世界的行为与我们的模拟相匹配:立体声方法将每个视点聚焦在不同的深度来为AiF重建引信互补提示,所恢复的深度与真实的场景几何相匹配,证实了该方法在模拟之外的适用性.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented a differentiable framework that jointly optimises camera design and downstream perception tasks, using 3D Gaussian representations reconstructed from real captures as a differentiable virtual environment for image formation. This avoids the scalability limits of derivative-free optimisation. We validated the framework on monocular and stereo depth-from-defocus tasks with jointly optimised coded apertures, sensors, and inter-camera geometry. It consistently outperforms fixed-camera and derivative-free baselines, while revealing interpretable design trade-offs that a decoupled process would miss. We believe this is an important step toward principled, automated camera design for autonomous systems that accounts for the interdependency between cameras and the algorithms that interpret them. For future work, we aim to extend the framework to jointly optimise camera count and array topology, and to incorporate adaptive, task-driven control of camera parameters online at inference time.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一个不同的框架,共同选择相机设计和下游感知任务,使用从真实捕捉中重建的3D高斯表示,作为图像形成的一种不同的虚拟环境. 这避免了衍生出自由优化的可伸缩性限制. 我们用联合优化的编码孔径、传感器和相机间几何技术验证了单相机和立体深度离焦点任务框架。 它的绩效始终高于固定相机和无衍生物基线,同时揭示出可解释的设计取舍,即脱钩过程会错过。 我们认为,这是朝着对自主系统进行有原则的自动相机设计迈出的重要一步,这些系统考虑到相机与解释相机的算法之间的相互依赖性。 就今后的工作而言,我们的目标是扩大框架,共同优化相机计数和阵列地形,并在推断时间纳入对相机参数的适应性和任务驱动控制。

blocks.en: Figure 6 : The monocular depth-from-defocus method. The backbone follows the U-Net of Ikoma et al. [ 16 ] , which takes a coded aperture image and its Tikhonov-deconvolved focal stack as input and jointly predicts the AiF image and depth map. We augment this backbone with a frequency injection module. In this module, the input image is divided into patches, a 2D Fourier transform is applied to each patch independently, and the log-magnitude spectrum is computed to capture local, spatially-varying defocus strength. The per-patch spectra are encoded by a lightweight 3-layer convolutional network, reassembled into a 2D feature map based on each patch’s location, and injected at the bottleneck of the U-Net.
blocks.zh: 图6:单向深度从焦点移出的方法。 骨干遵循了Ikoma等人的U-Net. [16],它取出一个编码孔径图像及其Tikhonov-deconvolved的焦堆作为输入并共同预测AiF图像和深度图. 我们用一个频率注射模块来增强这个骨干. 在这个模块中,输入图像被分为补丁,每个补丁独立应用了2D Fourier变换,并计算出日志放大谱来捕捉局部,空间变异的去聚焦强度. 每平分光谱由轻量级3层回旋网络编码,根据每个平分位置重新组装为2D特征图,并注入U-Net的瓶颈.

blocks.en: Figure 7 : The stereo depth-from-defocus method. Per-view AiF proxy images are synthesised by fusing the Tikhonov-deconvolved focal stack using a differentiable Laplacian sharpness measure and passed to a frozen RAPIDFlow [ 29 ] network to estimate dense disparity. The disparity is then used to warp the right-view into the left-view coordinate frame via bilinear grid sampling. The left-view focal stack, the warped right-view focal stack, and a depth map derived from the disparity estimate are concatenated and fed into the monocular U-Net backbone with frequency injection, yielding the reconstructed AiF image and depth map for the left view.
blocks.zh: 图7:立体声深度从分焦法. Per-view AiF代理图像是通过使用可分化的Laplacian锐度测量法来将Tikhonov-deconvolved焦堆相接而合成的,并传递给被冻结的RAPIDFlow [29] 网络来估计密度差异. 然后通过双线网格采样将相差度用于将右视图曲向左视图坐标框架. 左取景焦堆,被扭曲的右取景焦堆,和从差异估计得到的深度图被收缩并被以频率注入入到单元的U-Net主干线中去,为左取景产生重建的AiF图像和深度图.

blocks.en: Appendix A Depth-from-Defocus Networks
blocks.zh: 附录A 深度与重点 网络

blocks.en: We provide additional details of the depth-from-defocus networks used as perception tasks in our experiments. The structures of both the monocular and stereo versions are described in this section.
blocks.zh: 我们提供了更多细节,说明在实验中用作感知任务的从深度到重点的网络。 本节介绍单体和立体版本的结构。

blocks.en: A.1 Monocular
blocks.zh: A.1 单曲

blocks.en: As illustrated in Figure 6 , our monocular task network builds upon the depth-from-defocus architecture of [ 16 ] . The original method first applies a Tikhonov inverse filter to the rendered coded aperture images, using the PSFs to deconvolve them into a focal stack; each plane of this stack contains a relatively sharp region corresponding to that plane’s PSF. However, because the forward model for defocus blur simulation is non-linear, the Tikhonov inverse cannot directly invert this process to obtain the AiF image. The focal stack, together with the rendered coded aperture image, is therefore used as input to a convolutional neural network with a U-Net architecture, which outputs both the AiF image and depth map. Details of this architecture can be found in [ 16 ] .
blocks.zh: 如图6所示,我们的单一任务网络以[16]的从深度到重点的架构为基础。 最初的方法首先将Tikhonov反向滤波器应用到制成的编码孔径图像上,使用PSF将其分解为焦堆;这堆的每平面包含一个相对尖锐的区域来对应该平面的PSF. 然而,由于去焦模糊模拟的前向模型是非线性的,蒂克霍诺夫反向不能直接倒置这个过程来得到AiF图像. 因此,焦距堆与已渲染的可编码孔径图像一起,被用作一个带有U-Net架构的演化神经网络的输入,它输出出AiF图像和深度图. 此架构的细节可参见 [16].

blocks.en: A.2 Stereo
blocks.zh: A.2 立体声

blocks.en: For the stereo camera setup, we reuse the U-Net architecture with frequency injection from the monocular version as the base model, with modifications to its input. An illustration is displayed in Figure 7 .
blocks.zh: 对于立体相机的设置,我们重新使用从单相机版本的频率注入的U-Net架构作为基模,并修改其输入. 图7显示了一个插图。

blocks.en: We first estimate the disparity between the two views with a pretrained optical flow network, RAPIDFlow [ 29 ] , following [ 7 ] ; the network remains frozen during training. To obtain reliable optical flow estimates, we first construct an intermediate all-in-focus image per view by fusing the Tikhonov-inverted focal stack via a differentiable Laplacian sharpness measure, which improves photometric consistency across the two views. The fused images are then passed to RAPIDFlow to predict a dense disparity map, which warps the right-view focal stack into the left view’s coordinates via bilinear grid sampling. This provides additional photometric and defocus cues for AiF reconstruction and depth estimation. The left focal stack, the warped right focal stack, and a depth map derived from the disparity estimate are used as inputs to the same U-Net architecture as in the monocular setting, with the input shape modified accordingly; the network outputs the reconstructed AiF image and depth map for the left view.
blocks.zh: 我们首先估计两种观点之间的差异,一种是经过预先训练的光学流网,RAPIDFlow [29],在[7]之后;该网络在训练期间仍然被冻结。 为了获得可靠的光学流估计,我们首先通过不同拉普拉西安锐度测量法将Tikhonov倒置的焦距堆叠相接而形成一个中间的全焦成像,从而提高了两种观点的光度一致性. 然后将被熔接的图像传递给RAPIDFlow,以预测密密的差分图,通过双线网格取样将右视图焦距堆放入左视图坐标. 这为AiF的重建和深度估计提供了额外的测光和去聚焦提示. 左起焦堆,被扭曲了的右起焦堆,以及从差异估计得到的深度图被作为与单元设置相同的U-Net架构的输入,输入形状也相应被修改;网络输出重建后AiF图像和深度图用于左取景.

blocks.en: Figure 8 : Qualitative comparison for the monocular experiment under the Noise × \times 200 scenario. Our jointly optimised camera, mask, and perception model again produce sharp AiF images and accurate depth, while the fixed-camera baseline (Ikoma et al. blocks.zh: 图8:噪声×\times 200情景下的单体实验定性比较. 我们联合优化的相机,口罩和感知模型再次产生尖锐的AiF图像和准确的深度,而固定相机基线(Ikoma等 [16])和衍生出无联合取景器(TaCOS [44])则在这些区域产生更去焦模糊和更低深度精度的图像.

blocks.en: Appendix B Additional Qualitative Results on Monocular Camera Design
blocks.zh: 附录B 单相机设计的额外定性结果

blocks.en: We provide further qualitative comparisons for the monocular camera design experiment under the lower-SNR (Noise × \times 200) scenario in Fig. 8 . These results are consistent with the Noise × \times 100 scenario reported in the main paper: our method achieves better AiF reconstruction and depth estimation than the existing baselines. This further supports the effectiveness of jointly optimising camera hardware and perception under challenging noise conditions.
blocks.zh: 我们对图8中的下-SNR(Noise ×\times 200)情景下的单相机设计实验进行进一步的质量比较。 这些结果与主要文件中报告的噪音x\times 100情景一致:我们的方法比现有基线更能实现爱因斯坦重建与深度估计。 这进一步支持了在挑战性噪音条件下联合优化相机硬件和感知的效果.

blocks.en: Figure 9 : Qualitative comparison of the proposed stereo method with a coded aperture dual-pixel camera method (CADS [ 12 ] ) and the monocular alternative. Our method achieves better AiF reconstruction by combining varying focus planes across the two views, and better depth estimation by exploiting disparity as an additional cue.
blocks.zh: 图9:将拟议的立体法与可编码孔径双像素相机法(CADS [12])和单相机相机相机进行定性比较. 我们的方法通过结合两种观点的不同焦点平面来实现更好的爱因斯坦重建,并通过利用差异作为额外提示来进行更好的深度估计。

blocks.en: Appendix C Additional Qualitative Results on Stereo Camera Design
blocks.zh: 附录C 立体声相机设计的定性结果

blocks.en: Fig. 9 presents full qualitative comparisons between our method and the baselines across both noise scenarios. Our stereo setup achieves higher AiF reconstruction quality by combining photometric cues from both views under strong defocus blur, with one view focused on the foreground and the other on the background. Its depth estimation is likewise improved by exploiting disparity as an additional cue. The baseline methods, in contrast, are limited to a single focal distance by their hardware, resulting in lower AiF reconstruction quality and depth estimation accuracy under strong defocus blur.
blocks.zh: 图9全面比较了我们的方法和两种噪音情景的基线。 我们的立体声构型通过将两种观点的光度示意图结合到强烈的去聚焦模糊度下,实现更高的AiF重建质量,其中一种观点侧重于前地,另一种则侧重于背景. 其深度估计也通过利用差异作为又一线索而得到改善。 相比之下,基线方法的硬件限制在单一焦距内,导致AiF重建质量和深度估计精度在强烈去焦模糊下降低.

The AiF and depth recovery on real hardware show plausible outcomes but with modest accuracy gap attributable to the sim-to-real domain shift and manufacturing tolerances.

blocks.en: Appendix D Additional Details on Real-World Experiments
blocks.zh: 附录D 真实世界实验的细节

blocks.en: We validate our method with a real-world prototype of a coded aperture camera. As discussed in the main paper, we use a commercial FLIR Flea3 camera with a Fujinon DF6HA-1B lens due to manufacturing constraints. The lens has a fixed focal length of 6.15 mm; we additionally maximise the entrance pupil diameter by setting the f-number to 1.2, which eases production of the coded aperture mask. We optimise the coded aperture mask and the lens’s focus distance for both the monocular and stereo experiments, with the mask set to a 13 × \times 13 grid. A relay lens (Edmund Optics #46-007) then images the manufactured mask onto the entrance pupil of the main lens, placing the coded aperture at the pupil plane. The setup is shown in Figure 5 of the main paper.
blocks.zh: 我们用密码孔径相机的原型来验证我们的方法。 如正文所讨论,由于制造限制,我们使用带有富士农DF6HA-1B镜头的商用FLIR Flea3相机. 镜头的固定焦距为6.15毫米;我们通过将f-数设置为1.2来将入门瞳孔直径再最大化,这方便了编码孔径口罩的生产. 我们优化了密码孔径口罩和镜头的焦距, 用于单光和立体实验, 口罩设置为13xxxxtimes 13格. 接力镜头(Edmund Optics #46-007)再将所制造的口罩映射到主镜头的出入口瞳孔上,将编码孔径放入瞳孔平面. 设置见正文图5.

blocks.en: The manufactured mask’s PSF is measured by imaging a point light source at a known focus distance and source-to-camera distance. This measured PSF replaces its simulated counterpart in the image formation model, and we fine-tune the task network on the same training data for 1000 steps. Figure 10 (a) shows the optimised coded aperture mask for both monocular and stereo setups, the manufactured masks, and their measured PSFs.
blocks.zh: 所制造的口罩的PSF是通过成像在已知的焦距和源到相机相距上的点光源来测量的. 这个测量到的PSF取代了图像形成模型中模拟的对应器,我们用1000个步骤的相同的训练数据来微调任务网络. 图10(a)显示单眼和立体安装的最佳编码孔径口罩、所制造的口罩及其测量的PSF。

blocks.en: Figure 10 (b) shows the captured coded aperture image, reconstructed AiF image, and estimated depth map for the monocular setup, while the corresponding stereo results appear in Figure 5 of the main paper. Our method reconstructs sharp AiF images and plausible depth maps under real optical conditions, though the depth estimation lags behind the simulated results, with visible errors near the scene’s mid-plane. We attribute this shortfall to manufacturing tolerances and the broader gap between simulated and captured imagery. Comparing Figure 10 (b) with Figure 5 of the main paper, the stereo configuration yields higher depth accuracy than the monocular one, in line with our simulated results.
blocks.zh: 图10 (b) 显示了所捕获的编码孔径图像,重建的AiF图像,以及单相构型的估计深度图,而相应的立体结果则出现在正文图5中. 我们的方法在真实的光学条件下重建了尖锐的AiF图像和可信的深度图,尽管深度估计落后于模拟结果,在现场中飞机附近有明显的出错. 我们将此不足归因于制造耐受性和模拟图像与捕获图像之间更大的差距。 将图10(b)与正文图5相比较,立体构型的深度精度高于单相构型,与我们的模拟结果相符合.
